lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Carney meets with Chinese President Xi in Shenzhen, China, The Canadian Press reports.
United Airlines says it has a widespread system outage, just days after nationwide ground stop, The Associated Press reports.
A volunteer-run charity in Bragg Creek is trying to raise $50,000 by Friday, saying hundreds of thousands of dollars were drained from its bank accounts in a cyber attack, CTV News reports.

A former United States Ambassador to Canada says he’s optimistic a bilateral deal between the two nations is looming but cautioned Canadians not to expect a Democrat-controlled Congress to reign in President Donald Trump’s tariffs, The Canadian Press reports.
United Airlines said Monday that it had resolved a technology issue that delayed departing flights, just days after a malfunction in the U.S, The Associated Press reports.
UK leader Andy Burnham says Brexit hasn’t worked ahead of a reset summit with the EU, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
